function: GPS frontend with multiple protocol backends, receiver instance management, logging, RTC update and transport selection.
evidence: AP_GPS.cpp includes AP_SerialManager, AP_CANManager, AP_DroneCAN, AP_AHRS, AP_RTC and AP_Logger.
ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp, ArduPlane/Parameters.cpp and Rover/Parameters.cpp expose the module with prefix GPS.
AP_GPS.cpp declares top-level parameters such as _NAVFILTER, _AUTO_CONFIG and _PRIMARY.
AP_GPS_Params.cpp declares per-instance parameters TYPE, GNSS_MODE, RATE_MS, POS, DELAY_MS, COM_PORT, MB_ and CAN_NODEID.
